My research is about ecological change: what drives it, how fast it happens, and how confidently we can detect it. That has taken me from fossil pollen records spanning millennia to continental-scale simulations of boreal forests under future climates.

If you can't access any of the full articles, [get in touch](mailto:asenaq@caryinstitute.org) and I'll send you a copy. The same record with citation counts is on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=eKltz04AAAAJ) and [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4086-460X), and everything I write is open on [GitHub](https://github.com/QuinnAsena).

## Research summaries

Longer, plain-language write-ups of selected papers: what the question was, and what we found.
